# Platfer

Platfer is an education and coaching platform for teachers, coaching institutes and students in India.

## Product
Platfer provides live classes, recorded lectures, Smart Board, Notes + Voice, online tests, attendance, fees management, student records, batches, announcements, messaging, Communities, coaching profiles and student coaching discovery. Teachers can use the teacher platform free; students can join relevant coaching batches using Batch Codes and use learning features.

## Official Android app
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.platfer.app

## Company
- https://platfer.in/about-us — About Platfer: story, mission and founder
- https://platfer.in/disclaimer — Disclaimer for platfer.in content
- [Blog: Coaching fees system that gets you paid on time](https://platfer.in/blog/coaching-fees-paid-on-time): Platfer blog post — a practical four-part fee collection system for coaching teachers (fixed fee day, receipts, pending list, reminder).
- [Blog: 2-minute daily attendance routine that keeps batches full](https://platfer.in/blog/attendance-two-minute-daily-routine): Platfer blog post — a practical five-part daily attendance routine for coaching teachers (first-two-minutes marking, one list, three-day rule, parent message, monthly scan).
- [Blog: Fee reminder WhatsApp messages that get parents to pay](https://platfer.in/blog/fee-reminder-messages-that-work): Platfer blog post — a three-message fee reminder ladder for coaching teachers (two days before due date, on due date, three days late), with ready-to-send templates in Hindi and English, plus what to say to parents who always delay.
- [Blog: Your Coaching Does Not Need Its Own App]https://platfer.in/blog/your-coaching-does-not-need-its-own-app): Platfer blog post — why a teacher does not need to build their own coaching app — the real costs, the student download problem, and the shared-platform model where a teacher gets an app-like platform with all tools, free.

- [Blog: Tonight, a Student in Your City Is Searching for a Coaching]https://platfer.in/blog/students-searching-coaching-in-your-city): Platfer blog post — how students find and shortlist a coaching in their city today (city first, then subject, class, budget), and the five profile fixes that get a coaching onto the list students find.

- [Blog: Finding a Coaching in Your City: Check These Things Before You Pay the First Fee]https://platfer.in/blog/how-to-choose-a-coaching-in-your-city): Platfer blog post — a parent-and-student checklist for choosing a coaching in their city — seven checks before paying the first fee (real teacher, test feedback, full fee in writing, real batch size, recorded backup, trial classes, asking current parents).
- [Blog: Why students leave a coaching after one month — and the 3 things that make them stay](https://platfer.in/blog/why-students-leave-coaching-after-a-month): Platfer blog post — why students leave a coaching after the first month — usually silence, not teaching — and the three fixes that make them stay (visible attendance, same-day test results, receipts without asking).
- [Blog: How to set coaching fees that parents pay happily (without discounting your teaching)](https://platfer.in/blog/set-coaching-fees-parents-pay-happily): Platfer blog post — how to set coaching fees parents pay happily — full structure on day one, one due date, receipts, instalments instead of discounts.
- [Blog: The First 30 Days of a New Batch: A Routine That Fills Seats Instead of Emptying Them](https://platfer.in/blog/first-30-days-new-batch-routine): Platfer blog post — a week-by-week first-30-days routine for a new batch — fixed timetable, one small test, one parent update, fees before the month ends.
- [Blog: Online vs Offline Coaching: What Actually Works for Small-City Students](https://platfer.in/blog/online-vs-offline-coaching-small-city-students): Platfer blog post — online vs offline coaching honestly compared for small-city students — and why an offline batch run with online tools is the practical answer.
- [Blog: How to Prepare Your Batch for Board and Competitive Exams](https://platfer.in/blog/board-and-competitive-exam-preparation): Platfer blog post — how to prepare a batch for board and competitive exams — one backbone (finish the syllabus early, test weekly, revise in layers) with separate tracks for board answer-writing and NEET/JEE speed.
- [Blog: How to Run a Test Series That Actually Improves Scores](https://platfer.in/blog/how-to-run-a-test-series-for-your-batch): Platfer blog post — how to run a test series that improves scores — fixed test days, forward syllabus slices, same-week checking, and a discussion hour for the five worst questions.
- [Blog: The Last-Month Revision Plan: From Syllabus to Exam Hall](https://platfer.in/blog/last-month-revision-plan-for-exams): Platfer blog post — a last-month revision plan — three revision rounds that get shorter, weak topics in the morning, two full papers a week, and what to stop.
- [Blog: After the Results: How to Read Them and Make the Next Batch Better](https://platfer.in/blog/result-analysis-for-coaching-batches): Platfer blog post — how to analyse batch results after exams — topic-wise scores, slipped students, honest parent conversations, and three changes for the next batch.
- [Blog: Setting Up Live Classes: A Setup That Does Not Fail Mid-Lecture](https://platfer.in/blog/set-up-live-classes-for-your-coaching): Platfer blog post — a simple live-class setup for teachers — phone fixed in place, sound first, light on the face, large writing, same link, and a five-minute pre-class check.
- [Blog: Recorded Lectures Students Actually Watch](https://platfer.in/blog/recorded-lectures-students-actually-watch): Platfer blog post — how to make recorded lectures students watch — short concept videos, clear names in watch order, one question per video, and a weekly catch-up hour.
- [Blog: How to Keep Online Students Engaged When Nobody Is Watching](https://platfer.in/blog/keep-online-students-engaged-in-class): Platfer blog post — how to keep online students engaged — a question every ten minutes, cameras with a reason, calling students by name, short tasks, and private messages to quiet students.
- [Blog: Talking to Parents So They Trust Your Coaching](https://platfer.in/blog/parent-communication-that-builds-trust): Platfer blog post — a parent-communication rhythm — three-line weekly updates, bad news early with a plan, three surprise-preventing messages, and two honest meetings a year.
- [Blog: Fee Transparency: Show Parents Exactly What They Pay For](https://platfer.in/blog/fee-transparency-parents-appreciate): Platfer blog post — fee transparency parents appreciate — full fee in writing on day one, a receipt for every payment, no surprise charges, and public discount rules.
- [Blog: Progress Reports Parents Actually Read](https://platfer.in/blog/progress-reports-parents-actually-read): Platfer blog post — progress reports parents read — one page with attendance first, test trend instead of one score, one next step as an action, and a reply line.
- [Blog: An Attendance System That Runs Itself Every Day](https://platfer.in/blog/attendance-system-for-coaching-batches): Platfer blog post — an attendance system that runs itself — thirty seconds at the door, a same-day gap list, follow-up by rule, and a weekly pattern check.
- [Blog: How to Stop Proxy Attendance in Your Coaching](https://platfer.in/blog/stop-proxy-attendance-in-coaching): Platfer blog post — how to stop proxy attendance — fixed seating, entry-time marking, random roll calls, removing the reasons students proxy, and calm, consistent handling.
- [Blog: Link Attendance to Fee Collection (Without Awkward Conversations)](https://platfer.in/blog/link-attendance-to-fee-collection): Platfer blog post — linking attendance to fee collection — one shared record parents see, reminders quoting attendance, acting on dips before dues, and plans tied to return.
- [Blog: How to Recover Overdue Coaching Fees Without Losing the Student](https://platfer.in/blog/recover-overdue-coaching-fees-without-losing-students): Platfer blog post — how to recover overdue coaching fees without losing the student — calm reminder, meeting about the child, written plan both sides sign, and a rarely used last resort.
- [Blog: How to Handle a Parent Complaint Without Losing the Student](https://platfer.in/blog/handle-parent-complaint-without-losing-student): Platfer blog post — how to handle a parent complaint without losing the student — listen first, check attendance and test records, fix one visible thing, and follow up in writing the same evening.
- [Blog: When to Split a Batch: Signs Your Class Has Grown Too Big](https://platfer.in/blog/when-to-split-a-batch-too-big): Platfer blog post — seven signs a coaching batch has grown too big — doubt time gone, checking load, back-bench silence, attendance slipping at the edges — and how to split by pace without losing students.
- [Blog: Home Tuition Fees: How to Price Private Lessons Without Undercharging](https://platfer.in/blog/home-tuition-fees-price-private-lessons): Platfer blog post — how home tutors should price private lessons — real hourly cost including travel and preparation, rates by class tier, monthly packages, and raising fees once a year with notice.
- [Blog: Mock Tests Before Board Exams: How Many Are Enough?](https://platfer.in/blog/mock-tests-before-board-exams-how-many): Platfer blog post — how many mock tests a Class 10 or 12 batch needs before board exams — six to eight full-syllabus mocks, spaced a week apart, each followed by a five-item fix-list, stopping ten days before the exam.
- [Blog: When a Student Goes Silent: What to Do in the First 7 Days](https://platfer.in/blog/student-gone-silent-what-to-do): Platfer blog post — what to do when a coaching student goes silent — a calm 7-day plan: notice on day one, message the student first, find the real reason, offer one fix, and bring parents in as allies.
- [Blog: Your First 20 Students in a New City: A Practical Starting Plan](https://platfer.in/blog/first-20-students-new-city): Platfer blog post — how to get your first 20 students in a new city — a free demo week, five happy parents as referrers, teaching where students already gather, and turning 20 staying students into 40.
- [Blog: How to Check Answer Sheets Faster Without Missing Real Mistakes](https://platfer.in/blog/check-answer-sheets-faster): Platfer blog post — how coaching teachers can check answer sheets faster — three passes (objective sweep, method check, feedback), a pre-made answer key with partial-mark rules, and copies back in 48 hours.
- [Blog: Parent-Teacher Meetings Parents Actually Attend](https://platfer.in/blog/parent-teacher-meeting-parents-attend): Platfer blog post — how to run a coaching parent-teacher meeting parents actually attend — flexible slots, a personal invitation, a 10-minute format, and one agreed action per family.
- [Blog: How to Give a Fee Discount Without Training Parents to Wait for One](https://platfer.in/blog/fee-discount-without-training-parents-to-wait): Platfer blog post — how coaching teachers can give fee discounts without training parents to wait for offers — a reason, a limit, an expiry date, and something asked in return.
- [Blog: Morning or Evening Batch: Which Slot Fills First in Your City](https://platfer.in/blog/morning-vs-evening-batch-which-fills-first): Platfer blog post — morning or evening batch for a coaching — how school timings, parent routines and crowded slots decide which slot fills first, and how to test a slot with a two-week trial.
- [Blog: How to Set a Question Paper That Tests Understanding, Not Memory](https://platfer.in/blog/set-question-paper-tests-understanding-not-memory): Platfer blog post — how coaching teachers can set question papers that test understanding instead of memory — changed situations, why and what-if questions, and step marks that reward method.
- [Blog: What to Tell Parents When Their Child's Marks Drop](https://platfer.in/blog/tell-parents-when-child-marks-drop): Platfer blog post — what to tell parents when a child marks drop — prepare facts first, name one real cause without blame, and agree one small plan with a date to review it.
- [Coaching in Your City — Find and Be Found](https://platfer.in/coaching-in-your-city): how city-wise coaching discovery works on Platfer — students select their city and see every coaching there by subject, class and fees; teachers list free.

- [Coaching in Kota — JEE, NEET and the Teachers Behind Them](https://platfer.in/coaching-in-kota): coaching in Kota — JEE/NEET coaching capital; how students choose a batch over a brand, and how independent Kota teachers get discovered.

- [Coaching in Patna — Board, JEE, NEET and Govt Exam Classes](https://platfer.in/coaching-in-patna): coaching in Patna — Boring Road, Kankarbagh; board, JEE-NEET and government-exam classes; how Patna teachers get found beyond word of mouth.

- [Coaching in Delhi — UPSC, SSC, JEE-NEET and School Classes](https://platfer.in/coaching-in-delhi): coaching in Delhi — Mukherjee Nagar (UPSC), Laxmi Nagar (SSC/CA), JEE-NEET clusters and colony tuition; how Delhi students shortlist and teachers get discovered.

- [Coaching in Lucknow — Board Classes, SSC, UPPSC and JEE-NEET](https://platfer.in/coaching-in-lucknow): coaching in Lucknow — UP Board classes, SSC and UPPSC halls, growing JEE-NEET; recommendation culture and discovery.

- [Coaching in Indore — MP Board, JEE-NEET, CA and MPPSC](https://platfer.in/coaching-in-indore): coaching in Indore — Vijay Nagar and Bhawarkuan; MP Board, JEE-NEET, CA and MPPSC; students arriving from across MP.

- [Coaching in Jaipur — JEE-NEET Lanes, Board Classes and REET](https://platfer.in/coaching-in-jaipur): coaching in Jaipur — the Gopalpura JEE-NEET corridor and colony board/REET teachers; Rajasthan students choosing between Jaipur and Kota.

- [Coaching Glossary — Teaching and Coaching Terms, Simply Explained](https://platfer.in/coaching-glossary): a plain-language glossary of coaching terms — live class, recorded lecture, batch, test series, mock test, LMS, hybrid coaching, white-label app, trial class, retention and more.

- [Coaching App Cost in India — Build, Buy or Go Free?](https://platfer.in/coaching-app-cost-in-india): what a coaching app really costs in India — building your own (₹50,000–₹2,00,000+ plus yearly maintenance), white-label platforms, and the free platform route, with hidden year-two costs.
